name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-inner-map-clear-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString; ballerina/lang.map lists length, keys, hasKey, get, remove.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: map:length, map:keys, map:hasKey, map:get, map:remove; value:cloneWithType, value:fromJsonWithType, value:toString and value:toBalString.
reason: The expected panic depends on cloneReadOnly recursively freezing the inner map and removeAll rejecting its mutation. Neither value:cloneReadOnly nor map:removeAll is supported by the explicit langlib or method-call lists.
unsupported_constructs: Panic when clearing the recursively frozen inner map
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation marks the expected failure at m4.removeAll().
